Its coefficient data lie in N_(5u)(R_j), contained in the one-M protection since5u<=M. The core-to-domain margin is at least2u. actual_auxiliary_reference.conditional_covariance: C0=(Q_Z0,Z0)^(-1), a real principal FREE inverse of the original Q_DD. Raw blocks in DIFFERENT protected C_j cannot have a matrix coupling when the range is <=u and the one-M protection separates them; therefore C0 splits only across these protected groups. Keep every coupling within a merged group. This is not a principal hard-covariance identification.
actual_auxiliary_reference.local_square_root_reference: For each j set S_ref,j=j_Xstar*(Q_Xstar,Xstar)^(-1/2)*j_Xstar^sharp*S_Istar. It is real and uses only the data in C_j. Set Gamma_ref=Q_Z0,D\Z0 * P_(D\Z0) * sum_j S_ref,j. Its auxiliary X columns belong to disjoint Istar groups. This is a REFERENCE coupling matrix, not asserted to be a square root of a new physical covariance.
actual_auxiliary_reference.endpoint: The full direct words at sigma=1 give the actual S=Q_DD^(-1/2) and Gamma=Q_Z0,D\Z0*P_(D\Z0)*S. Retain C0 fixed on this bare covariance-only localization because its actual finite-range coefficient data are already in the protected region. Background/coarse-data locality beyond this fine-data statement remains open.

compensated_gaussian_identity.formula: For real positive C0 and ANY finite complex Gamma, integrating over B gives integral dmu_C0(B) exp[-B^T Gamma X-(1/2)X^T Gamma^T C0 Gamma X]=1, pointwise in real X. The transpose is bilinear transpose, not Hermitian adjoint. This is Gaussian completion with its compensator retained.
compensated_gaussian_identity.actual_conditional_formula: At Gamma=the actual endpoint and with X standard real Gaussian, B_E=P_E Q_DD^(-1/2)X has the actual marginal covariance. The inner B_Z0 has conditional mean -C0 Gamma X and covariance C0. Thus the compensated integral reproduces the ORIGINAL centered Gaussian coefficient. A physical real exterior mean m stays in the inserted functions as B_Z0+m_Z0; it is not set to0.
compensated_gaussian_identity.why_square_root_identity_not_needed: Away from sigma=1, the same compensated formula defines a normalized auxiliary complex family using C0 and Gamma_sigma. It does not require independently tagged S_sigma^2 to equal a tagged covariance. Absolute convergence of the X integral WITH the actual potentials still needs the source Gaussian margins; the formal normalized empty insertion is not a domination estimate.
compensated_gaussian_identity.reference_factorization: At Gamma_ref the raw B and auxiliary X variables separate across the protected C_j groups. The compensated functional factors for an actual insertion that is already a product on these groups. Any physical marked carrier or potential joining groups must be merged first. Shared exterior/background data remain fixed parameters and return in the original outer integral, so this is not independence of the physical sectors or history.
